checkedAlternates.risk: UNICEF is as famous globally as WHO and UNESCO.
checkedAlternates.resolution: UNICEF is a subsidiary UN fund/programme created by the General Assembly (group-4), whereas WHO, UNESCO, and FAO are autonomous treaty-based Specialized Agencies (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: The ICJ is a principal UN organ like the Security Council.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The ICJ is the sole principal judicial court sitting in The Hague (group-1), distinct from political charter councils (group-2).
